Class RunSummary

java.lang.Object
org.mavendb.loader.RunSummary
final class RunSummary extends Object
Machine readable summary of one execution, written as log/<timestamp>-<dbtype>.json next to the text log of the same run.

Written for failed runs too, with status FAILED and the error, so every run leaves a record. All durations are in milliseconds. Filled in on the main thread only.
